rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact — price is still below the 9-EMA ($10.29), well inside the $10.40 invalidation, and the single post-entry candle shows a tight consolidation (10.26–10.27) rather than a reversal push, suggesting no immediate absorption of selling pressure. However, the extremely low ATR ($0.02) and lack of directional follow-through in the first two minutes reduces conviction; with 155 minutes remaining and the VWAP target at $10.03, continuing to hold for thesis development is preferable to incurring the spread cost of an early exit.
